test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Online shopping refers to purchasing goods available on the world wide web. You have different websites which have a huge __________ of products that you can choose from.
solution:
The correct answer is '**assortment**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**assortment**" means a collection or variety of different items. (विविधता)
 
• Online shopping websites offer a wide range or assortment of products to choose from.
 
• The other options: "**assignment**," "**assessment**," and "**appraisal**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *You have different websites which have a huge assortment__ of products that you can choose from.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Assignment (कार्य)**: a task or piece of work allocated to someone.
 
• **Assessment (मूल्यांकन)**: the evaluation or estimation of the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something.
 
• **Appraisal (मूल्यांकन)**: an act of assessing something or someone.
